name: shield-violet
svg_template:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="-72 -72 144 144" width="144" height="144">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="disc-fill">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="${color-core}"/>
      <stop offset="0.36" stop-color="${color-rim}"/>
      <stop offset="0.69" stop-color="${color-rim}"/>
      <stop offset="0.74" stop-color="${color-halo}" stop-opacity="0.3"/>
      <stop offset="0.86" stop-color="${color-halo}" stop-opacity="0.09"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="${color-halo}" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <filter id="glow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="${blur-glow}"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>
  <rect x="-72" y="-72" width="144" height="144" fill="${color-bg}"/>
  <g transform="rotate(${rotate-pattern}) scale(${scale-shield})">
    <g filter="url(#glow)" opacity="${opacity-glow}">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="${opacity-glow};1;${opacity-glow}" dur="${pulse-glow}s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="-48" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
      <circle cx="48" cy="0" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="48" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
      <circle cx="-48" cy="0" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
      <g opacity="${toggle-inner}">
        <circle cx="0" cy="-25" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
        <circle cx="25" cy="0" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
        <circle cx="0" cy="25" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
        <circle cx="-25" cy="0" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
      </g>
      <g opacity="${toggle-diagonal}">
        <circle cx="-25" cy="-25" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
        <circle cx="25" cy="-25" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
        <circle cx="25" cy="25" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
        <circle cx="-25" cy="25" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
      </g>
    </g>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="-48" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="0" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="48" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
    <circle cx="-48" cy="0" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
    <g opacity="${toggle-inner}">
      <circle cx="0" cy="-25" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
      <circle cx="25" cy="0" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="25" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
      <circle cx="-25" cy="0" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
    </g>
    <g opacity="${toggle-diagonal}">
      <circle cx="-25" cy="-25" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
      <circle cx="25" cy="-25" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
      <circle cx="25" cy="25" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
      <circle cx="-25" cy="25" r="12.6" fill="url(#disc-fill)"/>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
